record.narrative: The new evidence refines the feature_063 picture while closing one dominant-predictor modification question. I accept H222: within the low-feature_018 stratum, feature_038 materially modifies feature_063 (signed interaction +0.790, 95% interval +0.562 to +1.018), well above the 0.15-unit threshold. This supports the same feature_038 context-dependence already seen for feature_063, even after conditioning on feature_018. I accept H217, H218, H220, and H212 as context-specific reverse associations of feature_063: feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 in a clean dominant-zero background with low feature_018 (H218: +0.393, lower +0.208; H220: +0.410, lower +0.213) and in the central feature_038 band without feature_018 restriction (H212: +0.298, lower +0.182). H217 is particularly strong in feature_010=0 with low feature_018/high feature_038 (+0.823, lower +0.656). These results argue that feature_063 is not only a high-feature_038 phenomenon in clean backgrounds; low-feature_018 contexts support a reverse association across part of the central feature_038 range. H212 and H214 remain active because their exposed cells are modest and/or their lower bounds are close to threshold; H214 (+0.463, lower +0.155, exposed n=23) is accepted cautiously as evidence that the reverse feature_063 association can persist even in a feature_010=1 high-feature_038 background, but the interval is wide and discovery-only. I leave H223, H221, H213, and H210 unresolved. H223 estimates a positive feature_038 modification within feature_018>=0 (+0.324, lower +0.075), and H221 estimates a positive reverse association in the clean high-feature_018 central band (+0.193, lower +0.059); both point toward persistence but neither excludes subthreshold values. H210 and H213 test high-feature_018/high-feature_038 direct contrasts more broadly and give estimates above threshold (+0.211 and +0.197) with lower bounds only +0.018 and +0.010, respectively. These suggest attenuation in high-feature_018 contexts but are not threshold-robust. I reject H219: the positive sign-reversal test at upper-feature_018 in the clean background gives estimate +0.005, interval -0.105 to +0.115, with the entire interval below the meaningful threshold. I reject H224: the feature_010-by-feature_019 median interaction is essentially null (+0.004, interval -0.139 to +0.132), and the upper bound is below threshold, so there is no evidence of meaningful age-median modification of the dominant feature_010 association. No validation is requested because voluntary validation requests are exhausted; consequently, acceptance is limited to contrasts whose discovery lower confidence limits exceed the threshold, and unresolved claims are kept only where the interval leaves meaningful effect plausible. All conclusions remain observational associations in the supplied dataset, with overlapping subgroup tests, multiplicity, small exposed cells in several feature_063 contrasts, and no causal, mechanistic, or biological generalizability claim.

prompt:
Iteration 15/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative: H187 due assessment: accept and close. The exact dominant-zero feature_063-by-feature_038 interaction is reproduced with threshold-robust magnitude: discovery R147 signed +0.596 (95% lower +0.464), independent validation R162 signed +0.508 (lower +0.312); both exceed the 0.15-unit threshold. Interpreted in the claimed reverse direction, this means that within records with feature_010=0, feature_037=0, and feature_002=0, the raw feature_063=1 versus feature_063=0 contrast is substantially lower when feature_038 is at or above 0 than when it is below 0. This strengthens the conclusion that feature_063 is a context-dependent secondary predictor and that feature_038 modifies it even after removing the dominant predictors. Overall supported findings: the supplied dataset contains three stable dominant associations: feature_010=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by about +0.83 composite units (discovery R11 and validation R25), feature_002=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by about +0.81 to +0.85 units (R73/R89), and feature_037=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 by about -0.80 raw units (H20 discovery R71 and validation R75). Tested pairwise interactions among these dominant predictors, including feature_010 by feature_019 median interaction H224, were rejected or near zero, supporting an approximately additive dominant-predictor structure rather than strong interaction among the strongest predictors. The secondary feature_063 evidence supports a reverse, context-dependent association: feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 and stronger composite dependency in feature_038-high and feature_018-low contexts, including accepted direct contrasts H178, H180, H195, H201, H206, H212, H217, H218, and H220, plus validated interactions H177, H187, H188, and accepted H222. This is a meaningful association in specific contexts, not a proven universal average effect. Negative findings: the constructed binary markers feature_007, feature_058, and feature_015 show no meaningful average association; many other opaque predictors and categorical levels are null; positive feature_063 sign-reversal tests are not supported, including H219 in the clean upper-quartile feature_018 context; feature_019 median does not meaningfully modify feature_010; low-feature_018 reverse effects are not supported when feature_038 is low; pairwise dominant-predictor interactions are not supported. Unresolved uncertainty: the global feature_063 reverse average H166 remains unresolved because discovery R126 and validation R175 both have point estimates above threshold but adjusted lower bounds just below it; this is suggestive but not threshold-robust. Central-band H209 and high-feature_018 contexts H210, H213, H221, and H223 remain unresolved, indicating that attenuation of feature_063 at higher feature_018 is plausible but not conclusively established. Several accepted feature_063 contrasts remain active because of small exposed cells, borderline lower bounds, or discovery-only evidence. Most informative next analysis: I registered a new direct test of whether the reverse feature_063 association persists in a broad high-feature_018, central-feature_038 background, refining unresolved clean high-feature_018 central-band evidence. This avoids another global average test and asks whether high feature_018 attenuates the effect even outside the exact dominant-zero eligibility. prompt:
Iteration 16/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

record.narrative:
No discovery assessments are due. The accepted dataset structure remains three large, reproducible dominant associations: feature_010=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by roughly +0.82 to +0.85 composite units, feature_002=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by roughly +0.81 to +0.85 units, and feature_037=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 by roughly -0.80 raw units. These tested interactions among the dominant predictors are null, supporting an approximately additive dominant structure. The unresolved secondary question is feature_063: the reverse association, meaning feature_063=1 associated with lower outcome_001 and stronger dependency, is robust in many feature_038-high and feature_018-low contexts, but it attenuates near zero or subthreshold in high-feature_018 contexts and in some central-feature_038 contexts. The global feature_063 reverse average remains suggestive but not threshold-robust. I therefore avoid another global average test and register targeted context refinements.

First, I propose a broad feature_010=0 restriction within the central feature_038 band. This tests whether the central-band lower bound is pulled toward subthreshold by the strong positive feature_010 contrast, or whether the central-band feature_063 reverse association is genuinely weaker. Second, I split that feature_010=0 central-band test into feature_018 nonnegative versus nonpositive contexts. This distinguishes feature_018 attenuation from central-band masking: if the reverse association is robust in low feature_018 but attenuated in high feature_018, the central-band evidence is likely a mixture of a real low-feature_018 effect and a high-feature_018 null. Third, I propose the analogous broad high-feature_018 central-band contrast without feature_010 restriction to assess whether the high-feature_018 attenuation persists in the full population, not only after exact dominant-zero or feature_010=0 conditioning. Fourth, I propose a low-feature_018, nonnegative-feature_036 contrast to test whether another standardized research signature defines an additional favorable context for the reverse feature_063 association.

For the dominant predictors, I register interaction tests between feature_010 or feature_002 and feature_063. These use positive direction to ask whether the dominant positive association is stronger in the feature_063=1 background, which could indicate compensatory nonadditivity or floor-like compression in lower-outcome backgrounds. Additivity predicts near zero, so anticipated direction is uncertain; these are effect-modification probes. Plausible alternatives include near-additivity, weak positive interaction, or unmeasured confounding by correlated dominant predictors. All central-band and feature_010=0 restrictions are expected to have enough exposed and comparator cells, but I will interpret any modest exposed cell cautiously.

No new independent validation is available, so acceptance will rely on discovery evidence. A newly proposed claim should be accepted only if its signed lower confidence limit exceeds the 0.15-unit threshold in the claimed direction. Claims with point estimates above threshold but lower limits below it will remain unresolved unless cached or scheduled validation already exists. All conclusions remain observational associations in this supplied dataset with opaque predictor labels, overlapping subgroup definitions, multiple testing, and no assigned biological mechanism, causality, or generalizability beyond the supplied and already-validated samples.

prompt:
Iteration 16/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

Therefore I request context-decomposition tests rather than another global average test.

I request H229 first. It tests the raw feature_063 reverse contrast in a broad high-feature_018, central-feature_038 background, without feature_010 restriction. Registered direction is -1, so a positive signed mean_difference means feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001, i.e., stronger composite dependency. This directly tests whether high feature_018 attenuates the reverse feature_063 association outside the exact dominant-zero eligibility. H226 tests the central feature_038 band after removing feature_010=1; H227 and H228 split that same feature_010=0 central band by feature_018>=0 and feature_018<=0. If feature_063 remains associated with lower outcome_001 despite the dominant predictors, it broadens feature_063 relevance beyond clean background restrictions. Both are direct mean_difference contrasts with registered direction -1; positive signed estimates favor the reverse association. These exposed feature_063 cells may be modest, so I will treat borderline intervals cautiously.

This asks whether the feature_063 association fails in high-feature_018 and low-feature_038 contexts, consistent with attenuation, or whether the accepted feature_038-high effects are not simply due to the central/low-feature_038 mixture. It is also a more direct probe of high-feature_018 attenuation than H210/H213 because it removes the dominant predictors and focuses on the low-feature_038 complement.

Their registered direction is +1, so a positive signed interaction means the dominant positive association is stronger in the feature_063=1 background than in the feature_063=0 complement. record.narrative:
The new results refine the feature_063 story and support approximately additive dominant-predictor behavior, but they also show that several feature_063 contexts remain uncertain. All estimates are interpreted exactly as signed to the registered directions; I did not multiply by direction again. For direct feature_063 claims with direction -1, a positive signed mean difference means raw feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001, i.e. stronger composite dependency. For feature_010-by-feature_063 and feature_002-by-feature_063 interactions with direction +1, a positive signed interaction means the dominant positive association is larger in the feature_063=1 background than in its complement.

Accepted direct feature_063 reverse associations. H228 is accepted: within feature_010=0 and the central feature_038 band, the feature_063 reverse association is robust in the feature_018<=0 stratum (signed estimate +0.349; lower bound +0.161). The lower bound clears the 0.15-unit threshold, but the exposed cell is only 53 and the lower bound is close to threshold, so I keep the investigation active for residual small-cell uncertainty. H230 is accepted: in the broader population with feature_018<=0 and feature_036>=0, feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 by +0.447 signed, with lower bound +0.258. This is the most useful new feature_063 context because it expands favorable context beyond feature_038 to nonnegative feature_036 while remaining feature_018-low. I close it as reasonably supported, though discovery-only. H215 is accepted: in feature_037=1 with feature_038>=0, feature_063=1 remains associated with lower outcome_001 by +0.481, lower bound +0.213. This indicates that the feature_063 reverse association can persist even on a low-outcome dominant-predictor background when feature_038 is nonnegative. The exposed cell is small (28), so active is appropriate. H216 is accepted: in feature_002=1 with feature_038>=0, feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 by +0.601, lower bound +0.335. This shows persistence even on a high-outcome dominant-predictor background with feature_038>=0. Exposed cell is 31, so I keep it active despite a robust lower bound.

Unresolved feature_063 contexts. H226 tests the same central feature_038 band with feature_010=0 but without splitting feature_018. The point estimate is above threshold (+0.243), but the lower bound is only +0.121; this is consistent with the accepted robust low-feature_018 component being diluted by a weaker or near-null high-feature_018 component. H227 tests that diluted high-feature_018 component directly and gives an estimate of +0.144 with lower bound -0.016, i.e. best estimate near threshold but not robust. H229 tests the broad high-feature_018 central band in the full population and gives +0.120 with lower bound -0.047; it is below threshold and includes negative values, though the upper bound still crosses 0.15. These results make high-feature_018 attenuation plausible, but the evidence is not threshold-robust. I keep H226 and H227 active because they remain directly relevant to context decomposition, but I close H229 because the broad full-population estimate is not promising and further work is better spent on direct feature_018 modification.

Rejected or closed non-robust claims. H211 is rejected: in the clean dominant-zero background with feature_018>=0 and feature_038<=0, the reverse feature_063 claim has signed estimate -0.076 and upper bound +0.023, far below threshold. This supports the interpretation that feature_063 relevance is not a clean low-feature_038/high-feature_018 phenomenon. H232 is rejected: the claimed positive feature_002-by-feature_063 interaction has signed estimate -0.114 and upper bound +0.093, so there is no evidence that feature_002's positive association is meaningfully amplified in feature_063=1 records. This supports additive dominant behavior. H231 is formally unresolved because the interval upper bound (+0.302) crosses the threshold, but the point estimate is only +0.098 and the interval includes zero and negative values; given that this is a dominant-predictor interaction probe and the dominant associations already show many null interactions, I close it as unsupported for now rather than keep it active.

Critical audit. The accepted feature_063 claims are observational associations in the supplied dataset, with many overlapping subgroup definitions and many prior tests. Acceptance is limited to cases whose signed lower confidence bounds exceed 0.15; this guards against accepting small-point or threshold-crossing intervals, but it does not control the full multiple-comparison burden. Several accepted claims have small exposed cells (especially H215, H216, and H228), so their intervals rely more strongly on Welch assumptions and could be sensitive to influential records. No leakage is available from the supplied analysis format, but confounding by correlated predictors remains possible because feature_063 effects are context-dependent and feature_038/feature_018/feature_036/feature_010/feature_037/feature_002 all appear in competing explanations. No causal or biological mechanism is claimed. No independent validation can be requested because voluntary validation requests are exhausted; therefore newly accepted claims are only those with threshold-robust discovery evidence. I registered two follow-up proposals: a direct feature_063-by-feature_018 interaction within feature_010=0 and the central feature_038 band to test high-feature_018 attenuation, and a clean dominant-zero feature_063 reverse contrast within feature_036>=0 to test whether H230's feature_036 context survives removal of dominant predictors.

prompt:
Iteration 16/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

Iteration 16/25, stage synthesize, attempt 2.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

record.narrative: The due response is H166, the global reverse feature_063 association. The comparison is signed to direction -1, so positive signed estimates mean raw feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 and stronger composite dependency. Discovery R126 gives signed estimate 0.239 with lower bound 0.145, and independent validation R175 gives signed estimate 0.285 with adjusted lower bound 0.146. Both point estimates exceed the 0.15-unit threshold and are directionally consistent, but neither lower bound clears it. I therefore keep H166 unresolved and close further pursuit of the global-average test. The best summary is that a global reverse feature_063 association is suggestive but not threshold robust; context decomposition is more productive than another global average test, especially because no independent validation requests remain. The supported dataset structure contains three large dominant associations: feature_010=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by about 0.82 to 0.83 composite units (R11/R25), feature_002=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by about 0.81 to 0.85 units (R73/R89), and feature_037=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 by about 0.80 raw units (R71/R75). Tested pairwise interactions among these dominant predictors are generally null, near zero, or not threshold robust (for example H101, H134/H135, H138/H139/H140, H224, H231, H232), supporting an approximately additive dominant structure rather than strong modification among the strongest predictors. The secondary feature_063 association is clearly context dependent. Feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 in several favorable contexts, including exact clean dominant-zero backgrounds, nonnegative feature_038 backgrounds, low feature_018 backgrounds, low feature_018 with nonnegative feature_036, central feature_038 with feature_010=0 and low feature_018, and some dominant-predictor backgrounds when feature_038 is nonnegative. The feature_038 modification is particularly robust: the interaction of feature_063 with nonnegative feature_038 is supported in the full population and remains robust after removing feature_010 or restricting to exact clean dominant-zero backgrounds (H177, H187, H188). Feature_018 also modifies feature_063: accepted positive feature_018 interaction claims indicate that the raw feature_063 contrast is shifted upward in high feature_018 backgrounds relative to its complement (H198, H191, H192), even though direct reverse feature_063 contrasts in many high feature_018 contexts are not threshold robust. Negative findings are substantial: the constructed binary markers feature_007, feature_058, and feature_015 have no meaningful average association (R4, R5, R6); a global positive feature_063 effect is rejected (H47); clean low feature_038 with high feature_018 reverse feature_063 effects are rejected (H211); a clean high-feature_018 positive feature_063 effect is unsupported (H219); feature_002 amplification by feature_063 is rejected (H232); and the feature_010 by feature_063 interaction probe is not robust (H231). Unresolved uncertainty remains concentrated in feature_063 context boundaries: global H166 is now unresolved closed, central feature_038 bands (H209, H226, H227) and several high-feature_018 direct contrasts (H210, H213, H221, H223, H225 if analyzed, H233, H234) remain suggestive, pending, or only small-cell supported. Some accepted feature_063 contrasts are active because exposed cells are small or discovery-only (for example H215, H216, H228, H182, H191, H192, H208). The most informative next analyses are therefore direct decomposition of the feature_036 and feature_018 modifiers after removing dominant predictors or removing feature_010 in the central feature_038 band. I registered new clean dominant-zero feature_063 by feature_036 interaction and clean dominant-zero feature_036 splits by feature_018, plus a central-band feature_010=0 feature_063 by feature_036 interaction. These test whether feature_036 is an independent favorable context, whether its effect survives removal of feature_010 and central feature_038 conditions, and whether feature_018 attenuation persists in the clean context. Existing unanalyzed registered claims H225, H233, and H234 are also high priority for the same reason. All conclusions remain observational associations in this supplied dataset with opaque predictor labels, overlapping subgroup definitions, multiplicity, possible correlated confounding, and no causal, biological, or generalizable mechanism claim.

prompt:
Iteration 17/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative: No discovery assessments are due. I preserve the accepted dominant dataset structure: feature_010=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by roughly +0.82 to +0.85 composite units, feature_002=1 is associated with higher outcome_001 by roughly +0.81 to +0.85 units, and feature_037=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 by roughly -0.80 raw units. Many tested dominant-by-dominant interactions are null or not threshold robust, supporting an approximately additive dominant structure. The main unresolved scientific question is the reverse feature_063 association: raw feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001, i.e., stronger composite dependency, in certain feature_038-nonnegative and feature_018-nonpositive contexts, while global and several central/high-feature_018 contexts remain suggestive or subthreshold. Because the global reverse feature_063 claim remains unresolved and no independent validation requests remain, I do not register another global-average test. Instead, I register targeted context decompositions and dominant-context checks. First, I split the accepted central-band, feature_010=0, feature_018-nonpositive feature_063 reverse contrast by feature_036 nonnegative versus nonpositive. If the reverse association remains robust when feature_036 is nonnegative but attenuates when feature_036 is nonpositive, feature_036 is an important modifier of the central-band feature_038/feature_018 context. The corresponding feature_036 interaction tests whether high feature_036 strengthens the reverse contrast relative to its complement. Second, I register a feature_063-by-feature_018 interaction restricted to feature_010=0, the central feature_038 band, and feature_036 nonnegative. This tests whether high feature_018 attenuates the reverse feature_063 association even within the otherwise favorable feature_036 context; direction +1 means the raw feature_063 contrast is shifted upward, i.e. less reverse, in high feature_018 relative to low feature_018. Third, I register feature_063 direct and interaction contrasts within feature_010=1 backgrounds, including low feature_038 and feature_038-by-feature_063 interaction tests, to determine whether feature_038 modification survives in a strong dominant-positive background. Fourth, I test whether the large dominant associations of feature_002 and feature_037 persist separately within feature_036 nonnegative and nonpositive halves; these are context checks for the additive dominant structure and are not expected to reveal feature_036 modification unless the dominant effects are highly context dependent. Finally, I test whether feature_063 remains associated with lower outcome_001 within feature_002=1 or feature_037=1 backgrounds when feature_036 is nonnegative, asking whether feature_063 relevance persists on dominant backgrounds without requiring feature_038. Plausible alternatives for feature_063 include true context dependence on feature_038/feature_018/feature_036, near-null after removing dominant masking, correlated-assay confounding among standardized signatures, or sparse-cell instability. Plausible alternatives for dominant predictors include approximate additivity, weak feature_036-specific attenuation, or residual confounding. For direct feature_063 claims with direction -1, a positive signed estimate means raw feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001. For interaction direction +1 with feature_018 nonnegative as the subgroup, a positive signed interaction means attenuation of the reverse feature_063 contrast in high feature_018. For interaction direction -1 with feature_036 or feature_038 nonnegative as the subgroup, a positive signed interaction means stronger reverse feature_063 association in that favorable context. Because no validation requests remain, new claims should be accepted only when the signed lower confidence bound exceeds 0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction. Claims with point estimates above threshold but lower bounds below threshold will remain unresolved, and small-cell accepted findings will be kept active rather than treated as definitive. All conclusions remain observational associations in this supplied dataset with opaque predictor labels, overlapping subgroup definitions, multiplicity, possible correlated confounding, and no causal, biological, mechanistic, or broad generalizability claim.

prompt:
Iteration 17/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

For all direct feature_063 claims with direction -1, positive signed estimates mean raw feature_063=1 is associated with lower outcome_001 and stronger composite dependency. For feature_018 interactions with direction +1, positive signed estimates mean the raw feature_063 contrast is shifted upward, i.e. less reverse, in the feature_018-high subgroup relative to its complement. For feature_036 or feature_038 interactions with direction -1, positive signed estimates mean the reverse feature_063 association is stronger in the favorable subgroup. H225 and H233 test central-band feature_018 attenuation directly and through interaction, especially in the feature_010=0 central feature_038 background. I request these Welch independent-cell discovery analyses, with 95% intervals and minimum cell sizes enforced by the controller.
